texts: A wraith drains six lanterns on the West Row.
The wraith fades back into the water of the Sunken Cove.
What happens to the drained lanterns?

fields.sentence: A wraith drains six lanterns on the West Row.

q2_gaps: Per-member distribution over a counted plural is specified only for plural SUBJECTS with a distributive predicate ("both dogs barked"); a counted plural OBJECT ("drains six lanterns") has no stated doctrine, so nothing makes an individual lantern's being drained queryable.

A restrictive locative PP on a counted plural ("six lanterns on the West Row") — the instruction set does not say whether the position rides the group symbol or distributes over the members the way a descriptive modifier does.
review.notes: Group witness + GroupOf + (Cardinality 6), Patient for an object the draining changes, Agent for the transitive subject, no status atom for the bare simple present, and West Row as a name with (Member west_row row) all follow the instruction set. On is the licensed entity-attached surface preposition, not a coined head.

fields.sentence: The wraith fades back into the water of the Sunken Cove.

q2_gaps: the restitutive / directional adverb "back" ("fades back into the water") — not one of the four licensed aspectual particles (again / still / already / yet), not a lexicalized phrasal-verb particle, and with no Manner or oblique slot that fits, so it is dropped with no carrier and no test is given for separating it from a particle verb
review.notes: `fade` is named in the instruction set's internal-change-of-state list so `Patient` on the wraith is right, the bare simple present correctly takes no tense atom, and "the Sunken Cove" gets the whole-name symbol plus its kind atom with no modifier genus. The context's `sk_wraith_1` is reused with none of its atoms re-emitted, and the fresh `sk_water_1` / `sk_fade_1` indices do not collide.

fields.sentence: What happens to the drained lanterns?

q1_issues.issue: The query relates the unknown event to the lantern group with the preposition-named oblique (To $e sk_group_1), but a statement that answers "what happens to the drained lanterns" would store the group in an undergoer role (Patient / Theme / Experiencer), so the pattern is not built "exactly as the matching statement" and can bind nothing in the KB.

q2_gaps: An open "What happens to X?" question: the instruction set supplies only the agent-side analogue ("What does Bob do?" -> (Member $e $verb) (Agent $e $b)) and no undergoer-side form, since the role head varies with the unknown verb, a variable is never licensed in head position, and the dual-storage-union list does not include alternative role heads.
review.notes: Referent handling is right: the definite plural "the drained lanterns" is the context's group sk_group_1 (the Patient of the drain event), used as a constant with no re-emission of its GroupOf / Cardinality atoms.

issues.reason: Queries requires the pattern be built exactly as the matching statement, and the very statement that answers this question is already in the context as (Patient sk_drain_1 sk_group_1) - the To oblique binds the goal-style slot instead of that undergoer role, so the query matches nothing though the answer is present.

gaps_confirmed: No undergoer-side analogue of "What does Bob do?": the event-class slot may hold a variable but a role head may not, and no role-union is licensed, so "What happens to X?" has no complete licensed form.
new_gaps: A licensed "what happens to X" form would have to carry an OPEN UNDERGOER: either an undergoer-neutral head, or a sanctioned union of query lines over Patient / Theme / Experiencer - the dual-storage-union list is closed and does not include alternative role heads.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant single line here is (: $prf (And (Member $e $verb) (Patient $e sk_group_1)) $tv), which binds the context's drain event; a form that also covers Theme / Experiencer storage is not licensed, since neither a variable role head nor a role-union is sanctioned.
adjudication.notes: Referent handling is right: the definite plural is the context's group sk_group_1, used as a constant with no re-emission of its GroupOf / Cardinality atoms.
